text: v0.114.21 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v0.114.21 — the Bet button now sits on every PropLine card that has a slip (no expanding needed). The engine also restarted with the fix so the pull-to-refresh works mid-scan; update the app, then pull down on the PropLine screen (~10 s to a few minutes for the sweep).
